case ID       Owner's requested outcome
close-only    Close the terminal, retaining the worktree and branch.
reopen        Open a terminal for this existing worktree.

merge-clean   Merge into release/2026 and remove terminal, worktree, and branch.

keep-branch   Remove terminal and worktree, but retain the local branch without merging.
